description: The bar chart, titled "Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models," displays the number of tasks associated with various language families and individual languages, with the horizontal axis representing the number of tasks (labeled "# tasks") on a linear scale from 0 to 80, and the vertical axis listing the language categories. The categories, from top to bottom, are IE-Slavic, IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque. The length of each horizontal bar corresponds to the number of tasks for that category. IE-Slavic has the longest bar, indicating the highest number of tasks at approximately 79. IE-Romance follows with a value of about 47, and IE-Germanic has approximately 44 tasks. The remaining categories have progressively fewer tasks: Uralic (around 20), IE-Baltic (around 17), IE-other (around 15), IE-Indic (around 10), Semitic (around 8), Turkic (around 5), and Basque (around 4). The bars are sorted in descending order of task count.
